q: Is there published research behind this?
a: Yes. A 12-month observational study of 43 children diagnosed with ASD found statistically significant gains across CARS, Vineland, DST and REEL scores when the platform was used consistently alongside standard therapy.

q: How does CognitiveBotics support a centre’s existing therapy process?
a: CognitiveBotics helps centres extend therapy beyond the session with structured daily intervention support, consistent parent-led reinforcement, continuous progress tracking, real-time therapist visibility and objective outcome measurement.

q: How does a centre join the CognitiveBotics platform?
a: CognitiveBotics works with centres to connect therapy at the clinic with learning at home. Therapists set goals and activities on the platform, which are then extended to parents through short, guided videos.

q: Is CognitiveBotics suitable for NGOs, not just private therapy centres?
a: Yes. NGOs and community-based developmental programs use the same connected model; a clinician-directed plan, reinforced consistently at home, tracked centrally.
